title: Petstock: 30% Cashback ($35 Cap Per Member, Exclusions Apply) @ TopCashback AU
body:
Deal: Petstock: 30% Cashback ($35 Cap Per Member, Exclusions Apply) @ TopCashback AU

[VladImpaler] 20% uncapped til 9pm on ShopBack, up to 23% with card bonus and Plus. I did one order with Topcashback and another with ShopBack 🤞🤞 they track.
Edit: Topcashback tracked within 20 minutes, $35 back on $132 purchase already discounted down from $166.
[Xizor] Its untill 9AM tomorrow not 9PM tonight.
[VladImpaler] @Xizor: I stand corrected, 8pm to ""9am"
[New Chump] @Xizor: Don’t click through well before 9am, but submit the order 1 second after 9am.
Ask me how I know :(
[FLICKIT] I don't know how they cover this, they must have decent mark ups..
The horse feed I buy is usually $26.89 per 20kg bag, with the After-Dark sale price of $24.20 and cashback it's under $17… (or $17.20 each for 5 bags maxing out the cashback)
They always pay out the cashback real fast also, 1-month….
[woolly] My bad, seems like what I wanted genuinely is out of stock :(
[JoeyJoeJoe] My boy thanks you. He’s getting a load of Ziwi Peak!
[zakarados] first order was instant. second has been over a hour and not tracked
[tripdubz] Damn looks like I have a problem with mine. Been an hour now and nothing
[I like cats] Petstock never tracks automatically for me for some reason, I always end up submitting a missing claim. My last order (from Sep) is still pending a decision, but a claim I made in Feb was approved pretty quickly.
[FLICKIT] @I like cats: That's odd, I've never had an issue with them tracking, Chrome on a PC with adblocker disabled for Petstock.. .
[I like cats] @FLICKIT: Lucky you! I disable my Adblock for TopCashback but it’s still hit and miss for tracking.
[nfr] @FLICKIT: It's a mystery. My desktop Chrome had only TCB extension because it was strictly used for cashbacks, used to track well until this year when only Petstock stopped tracking. After 3 misses in a row I now use mobile instead.
[tripdubz] @nfr: My first order that didn't track was on mobile. I tried a second order using Chrome on desktop and not tracked either. Weird as I usually don't have any problems at all.
[FLICKIT] According to this, yes: https://www.ozbargain.com.au/comment/17757646/redir
[demod] Ordered. Using edge - which i never use. No tracking after 30 min
[Xizor] Hmmm strange. Normally get fast tracking for these but nothing after 2hrs.
[Benjamin7711] Tracked within 4 minutes for me. Although that was at like 7.30 aest
